reviews.review:
This game is NOT worth $40. If it was $10 then I would recommend it, but cannot at the current price. The main story took a little under 2 hours to complete, which is not enough content for the price. I understand it's Barbie, but when you are competing with games at this price point the game has to be better.
I liked the dress up aspect, and that you can customize your horse. You cannot customize your character--you pick one of two options, which was disappointing. Having the ability to customize your own barbie would be really cute. I did like the representation of different skin tones and abilities. If that was incorporated into character customization that would really set this apart from other games. This is a cute and simple game, and if you are interested I would wait until it's got a big discount, because it's just not worth $40 for me.
